88595.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace).
  3. Two custom roles made from the same template (e.g. Service Advisor): ZZAUTOTEST With Reports (Reports switched on) and ZZAUTOTEST No Reports (Reports switched off).
  4. Two staff members at that location whose sign-ins you have: ZZAUTOTEST Reports User with role ZZAUTOTEST With Reports, and ZZAUTOTEST No Reports User with role ZZAUTOTEST No Reports.
  5. You have copied the dashboard's web address.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list.
  • For 3: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Create Custom Role > Choose a template: Service Advisor > Apply > Role Name ZZAUTOTEST With Reports > under Page Access switch Reports on > Create. Then the second role the same way: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Create Custom Role > Choose a template: Service Advisor > Apply > Role Name ZZAUTOTEST No Reports > under Page Access switch Reports off > Create.
  • For 4: profile icon > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: First Name and Last Name (ZZAUTOTEST Reports User), an Email you can open, Role ZZAUTOTEST With Reports, a Department, Location = your location > Save & Close; accept the invitation email and set a password, so you can sign in as them; then the same for ZZAUTOTEST No Reports User with role ZZAUTOTEST No Reports.
  • For 5: while signed in as Admin, click Dashboard in the top menu and copy the address from the browser bar.
88595.custom_steps:
1. In a private browser window, sign in as ZZAUTOTEST Reports User.
  2. Look at the top navigation bar.
  3. Sign out (profile icon > Logout), then sign in as ZZAUTOTEST No Reports User.
  4. Note which screen you land on after signing in.
  5. Look at the top navigation bar.
  6. Paste the dashboard address you copied into the browser bar and press Enter.

88596.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. For the setup you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission).
  2. A staff member whose role has the Reports permission switched off, with access to one location, whose sign-in you have (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST No Reports User with role ZZAUTOTEST No Reports).
  3. You have copied the dashboard's web address.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Create Custom Role > Choose a template: Service Advisor > Apply > Role Name ZZAUTOTEST No Reports > under Page Access switch Reports off > Create; then profile icon > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: First Name and Last Name (ZZAUTOTEST No Reports User), an Email you can open, Role ZZAUTOTEST No Reports, a Department, Location = your location > Save & Close; accept the invitation email and set a password, so you can sign in as them.
  • For 3: while signed in as Admin, click Dashboard in the top menu and copy the address from the browser bar.

88597.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You are in any location (workplace).
  3. You have a small screen ready: a phone, or a tablet held upright, or a desktop window made narrower than 1024 pixels (the dashboard tiles stack into one column when it is narrow enough).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list.
88597.custom_steps:
1. On a desktop-width window, click Dashboard in the top menu.
  2. Hover the mouse over the shop logo at the far left of the top bar.
  3. Click the shop logo.
  4. Open the site on the small screen.
  5. Tap the shop logo.
  6. Tap the menu button beside the logo (the icon with three lines).

88598.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You open the site in a fresh private (incognito) browser window, so nothing remembered from an earlier visit is in play.
  3. Two locations (workplaces) whose figures differ: your normal location (e.g. Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) and one with nothing in it (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: both are in the Change Location list (click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list). If no empty location exists, create one: profile icon > Settings > Locations > New Location: Name (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop), Address 1, City, State/Province, ZIP/Postal Code, Timezone, Telephone > Save & Close; it appears in the Change Location list at once. Create nothing in it.
88598.custom_steps:
1. Change location to your normal location (profile icon > Change Location) and click Dashboard in the top menu.
  2. Write down the six tile headlines (e.g. Revenue $2,422.00).
  3. Without leaving the dashboard, change location to ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop (profile icon > Change Location).
  4. Read the six tile headlines again.
  5. Change location back to your normal location.
  6. Look for any way to have no location selected (for example in the Change Location list).

88599.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. A second staff member whose role is different but also has the Reports permission (e.g. a Service Manager), whose sign-in you have.
  4. You are in any location (workplace).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: check the role has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on Service Manager > Reports is switched on. If you have no such staff member: profile icon > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: First Name and Last Name (ZZAUTOTEST Second Viewer), an Email you can open, Role Service Manager, a Department, Location = your location > Save & Close; accept the invitation email and set a password, so you can sign in as them.
  • For 4: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list.

88600.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. You are in any location (workplace).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list.
88600.custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu.
  2. Look over the whole page, each tile's header and corners, and the top of the page for any button, menu, pencil, gear, plus sign, close cross or eye icon.
  3. Right-click a tile and look at the menu that opens.
  4. Try to drag a tile by its title to another position.
  5. Sign out (profile icon > Logout), sign in again and click Dashboard in the top menu.
  6. Open the dashboard in a different browser or a private window.
